fix_decisions.evidence: Deleted the absolute clause 'The rewritten statement is never shown to the client.' from docs/external/row-level-security.md; a MySQL error passed through run_sql can quote the rewritten statement. No acceptance criterion requires the clause (criteria 9 and 10 name rule-sets.md and configuration.md content only); the remaining sentence states the show_details behavior.

Deleted 'The rewritten SQL is never shown: ...' from docs/external/rule-sets.md Limits bullet; DB error text can quote it. Criterion 9 (heading, note line, as_written, model SQL before rewrite) still holds on the remaining bullet text.

phase3_findings.description: outgoing_query_info returns the caller's own dict when no guard applies; internal and outgoing query shapes are both plain dicts, so the outgoing-only invariant rests on convention.
has_rewriting_guard mirrors factory.py wiring conditions rather than asking which guards were wired; the Markdown and metadata labels are decided at two call sites.
